summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor (returns True when written to a terminal, False otherwise, no Windows calls); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not run: tests and Black were not executed per instructions, so results are unverified. Nothing committed.
